cover_headline: Neena Gupta, Who Answered a 70-Year-Old Maths Problem, Named to TIME100 Next India

end.headline: Neena Gupta, Who Answered a 70-Year-Old Maths Problem, Named to TIME100 Next India
end.line: The ISI Kolkata professor found a counterexample to the Zariski Cancellation Problem in 2014. TIME's new India list puts her among its Health and Science Innovators.

facts: In 2014 she found a counterexample to a version of the Zariski Cancellation Problem, a question in algebraic geometry first posed by Oscar Zariski in 1949
Her honours include the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize in 2019, the Ramanujan Prize in 2021 and the Infosys Prize in Mathematical Sciences in 2024
Gupta completed her mathematics honours degree at Bethune College in 2006 and her PhD at ISI Kolkata in 2011
